title: How Many Pawns to BEAT Magnus?
summary: Very long (~80 min) 'how many pawns to beat the Magnus bot': king plus only pawns, starting with two full rows (16 pawns, including pawns on the back rank) and adding two pawns each game, vs Magnus's full army. Back-rank pawns can only step one square at first; from rank 2 they move normally. Magnus keeps breaking through and mating him in the middle of the board; at the end he misses a forced mate-in-four (plays g6 instead) and wraps up the 'experiment' with no confirmed win (thumbnail '40 Pawns? No.').
rules: Player (White): king + pawns only; game 1 = ranks 1 and 2 filled with pawns (16) around the king; +2 pawns each game.
Pawns on the 1st rank may only move one square; once on rank 2 they may double-step like normal pawns.
Magnus bot: full army. Normal chess rules; promotion as normal.
win_condition: Checkmate Magnus (no win shown; experiment ended at ~40 pawns).

opponent.name: Magnus (chess.com bot)
opponent.avatar_description: Small photo-style avatar; remake original cartoon GM.
